desc: Ideation: reverse-DP + greedy walk approach, O(n*26) transitions via min1/min2, memory via array('i')
Implement full solution: cost table, reverse DP with array('i') rows and min1/min2 switch optimization, greedy reconstruction, wrapped in class Solution
Test against examples and edge cases (n=1,2,5 impossible; n=3,4,6,7; all-same; already-good; lexicographic ties); brute-force cross-validation on 1500+ strings with zero mismatches
Performance sanity check: O(n*26) time (~0.5s), ~16MB memory, no int32 overflow (INF=1e9, max cost 1.25e6)
